E0955

Comptime file input missing / unreadable (`embed_file` also: not UTF-8)

What

Comptime file input missing / unreadable (`embed_file` also: not UTF-8)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0955

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0955: tests/ui/comptime_embed_bytes_missing.stderr.

Error [E0955]: `embed_bytes` can't open `does_not_exist.bin`
  --> tests/ui/comptime_embed_bytes_missing.jet:1:10
    |
  1 | @data :: embed_bytes("does_not_exist.bin")
    |          ^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: no such file or directory (os error 2) (looked next to the file doing the embedding)
 Fix: check the path — it is relative to the file's own directory
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0955

Error [E0107]: nothing named `@data` exists here
  --> tests/ui/comptime_embed_bytes_missing.jet:4:13
    |
  4 |     print("{@data}")
    |             ^^^^^
 Why: a name must be declared before it's used
 Fix: declare it first: `@data :: ...`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0107
